title: VulValidate: Auditing Function-Level Vulnerability Labels with Executable Evidence
title_zh: VulValidate：基于可执行证据的功能级漏洞标签审计

paragraphs.en: Reliable learning-based vulnerability detection requires high-quality labels, yet widely used datasets built from vulnerability-fixing commits may label functions as vulnerable simply because they were changed by a security patch. Such label errors can affect both model training and evaluation. We present VulValidate , a framework that uses LLM agents to coordinate dynamic analysis tools and build vulnerability-triggering experiments from runtime feedback. Given a labeled function and its fixing patch, VulValidate reconstructs the historical vulnerable and fixed revisions, analyzes the possible vulnerability, selects suitable tools and execution paths, iteratively refines triggering inputs, and compares runtime behavior across the two revisions. The resulting evidence is used to assess whether the observed defect can be attributed to the labeled function and is preserved for inspection and replay. We apply VulValidate to all 35,849 instances originally labeled vulnerable in BigVul, PrimeVul, and DiverseVul. Of these, 20,510 are confirmed (57.2%), 6,819 receive label corrections (19.0%), 7,981 remain attacked but undecided (22.3%), and 539 are not successfully measured (1.5%). After resolving identified label conflicts and removing byte-exact duplicates, the corrected release contains 15,890 distinct confirmed vulnerable function bodies. In a blinded review of 581 decisions randomly sampled from the three datasets and outcome groups, the final reviewer consensus supports 90.0%–92.0% of sampled confirmations and 92.6%–99.0% of sampled label corrections. Keeping model parameters fixed, evaluation with the corrected labels lowers F1 for all five tested detectors on both BigVul and DiverseVul. Retraining with corrected labels then improves F1 over evaluation without retraining for four of five detectors on each dataset. We also release a reusable VulValidate skill for applying dynamic tools to additional vulnerability instances. The corrected datasets, reproducible evidence, and reusable skill provide a stronger basis for vulnerability detection research and future dataset construction.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠的基于学习的漏洞检测需要高质量的数据标签，然而广泛使用的、由漏洞修复提交构建的数据集可能会仅仅因为某个函数被安全补丁修改而将其标记为存在漏洞。 这类标签错误会影响模型训练和评估。 我们提出了 VulValidate——一个利用 LLM 智能体协调动态分析工具，并根据运行时反馈构建漏洞触发实验的框架。 给定一个已标记的函数及其修复补丁，VulValidate 会重建其历史上存在漏洞和已修复的版本，分析潜在的漏洞，选择适当的工具和执行路径，迭代优化触发输入，并比较两个版本在运行时的行为差异。 由此获得的证据可用于判断观察到的缺陷是否可归因于该已标记的函数，并保留下来以供检查和重演。 我们将 VulValidate 应用于 BigVul、PrimeVul 和 DiverseVul 中最初被标记为存在漏洞的全部 35,849 个实例。 其中，20,510 个得到确认（57.2%），6,819 个获得了标签修正（19.0%），7,981 个仍处于攻击状态但结论未定（22.3%），另有 539 个未能成功测量（1.5%）。 在解决已识别的标签冲突并移除字节完全相同的重复项后，修正后的发布版本包含 15,890 个独特的、经确认存在漏洞的函数体。 在对从三个数据集和结果组中随机抽取的 581 项决策进行盲审时，最终评审者的共识支持了 90.0%–92.0% 的确认样本以及 92.6%–99.0% 的标签修正样本。 在保持模型参数不变的情况下，使用修正后的标签进行评估会降低所有五个受测检测器在 BigVul 和 DiverseVul 上的 F1 值。 随后使用修正后的标签重新训练，使得五个检测器中有四个在每个数据集上的 F1 值优于未重新训练的评估结果。 我们还发布了一个可复用的 VulValidate 技能，以便将动态分析工具应用于更多的漏洞实例。 这些经过修正的数据集、可重现的证据以及可复用的技能，为漏洞检测研究和未来数据集的构建提供了更坚实的基础。

paragraphs.en: Vulnerability detection is essential to software security, and the growing volume of reported vulnerabilities increases the need for scalable analysis and reliable validation. In April 2026, NIST announced that the National Vulnerability Database would prioritize enrichment according to risk, following a 263% increase in CVE submissions between 2020 and 2025 ( National Institute of Standards and Technology, 2026 ) . Learning-based detectors offer a way to prioritize potentially vulnerable code, but their training and evaluation depend on the quality of function labels. Inaccurate labels can reward agreement with dataset artifacts while obscuring whether the underlying defects are detected ( Croft et al., 2023 ; Risse et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 漏洞检测对软件安全至关重要，而报告漏洞数量的持续增长使得可扩展的分析和可靠的验证变得愈发必要。 2026年4月，美国国家标准与技术研究院（NIST）宣布，国家漏洞数据库将根据风险优先级进行数据丰富，这是基于2020年至2025年间CVE提交量增长263%的结果（美国国家标准与技术研究院，2026）。 基于学习的检测器提供了一种优先处理潜在脆弱代码的方法，但其训练和评估效果取决于函数标签的质量。 不准确的标签可能会因与数据集中的特定模式一致而获得误判的“奖励”，同时掩盖了底层缺陷是否被真正检测到的事实（Croft等，2023；Risse等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Widely used datasets, including BigVul, DiverseVul, and PrimeVul, derive function labels from historical vulnerability information and source changes ( Fan et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Ding et al., 2024 ) . Collection rules differ, and PrimeVul refines labelling and deduplication procedures ( Ding et al., 2024 ) . Identifying a vulnerability-fixing commit and identifying the function responsible for the defect are different tasks. A repair can change a faulty parser, its callers, tests, and unrelated code. Labelling changed functions from commit membership can therefore confuse participation in a repair with responsibility for the vulnerability. Static-analyzer datasets such as D2A use differential analysis of warnings across revisions, providing another basis for candidate labels ( Zheng et al., 2021 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 广泛使用的数据集，包括 BigVul、DiverseVul 和 PrimeVul，其函数标签均源自历史漏洞信息和源代码变更（Fan 等，2020；Chen 等，2023；Ding 等，2024）。 这些数据集的收集规则各不相同，而 PrimeVul 则对标签标注和去重流程进行了优化（Ding 等，2024）。 识别修复漏洞的提交记录与确定导致缺陷的函数，是两项不同的任务。 一次修复可能会改变有问题的解析器、其调用者、测试用例以及无关的代码。 因此，通过提交记录成员关系来标注发生变化的函数，可能会将参与修复的行为与对漏洞的责任混为一谈。 D2A 这类静态分析器数据集通过对比不同版本中的警告信息来进行差异分析，从而为候选标签提供了另一种依据（Zheng 等，2021）。

paragraphs.en: Prior audits show that these issues affect benchmark quality. Croft et al. found that 20% to 71% of vulnerability labels were inaccurate in the real-world datasets they examined and that duplication could inflate model performance ( Croft et al., 2023 ) . Risse et al. examined 100 functions labelled vulnerable from each of BigVul, Devign, and DiverseVul, finding actual vulnerabilities in only 39, 47, and 65 functions, respectively. Their survey also found that 53 of 81 vulnerability-detection papers used at least one of BigVul, Devign, or ReVeal ( Risse et al., 2025 ) . Together, these audits motivate improving the labels used by existing detectors, alongside developing new architectures.

paragraphs.en: Our joint analysis identifies conflicting labels across the three studied datasets. After removing comments and normalizing whitespace, 2,707 of 25,807 unique function bodies labelled vulnerable also appear with a non-vulnerable label, corresponding to 10.49%. Of these conflicts, 2,210 occur across datasets. Such matching bodies provide contradictory supervision when the datasets are combined. Resolving them requires evidence about the relevant function and source context.

paragraphs.en: Dynamic analysis provides a useful basis for examining these labels. Source and patch analysis can identify suspected defects and guide testing, while execution tests whether a concrete input reaches the relevant operation and produces an observable failure. A mechanism-appropriate oracle, together with coverage and attribution evidence, can connect that failure to the labelled function. Replaying the same condition on the fixed revision tests whether the repair changes the observed behavior ( Hazimeh et al., 2020 ; Barr et al., 2015 ; Mei et al., 2026 ) . For example, memory instrumentation can expose an invalid access, while authorization and resource failures require oracles matched to their security consequences. Attribution must connect the observed fault to the labelled function, and a harness must preserve relevant guards and calling conditions. These requirements help distinguish a defect in the historical code from a failure introduced by the test (Section 2.3 ). The scope of the evidence matters as much as its presence: an unsuccessful search may reflect incomplete coverage, limited inputs, or an unsuitable oracle, so failure to trigger a defect is not by itself grounds for a non-vulnerable label ( Klees et al., 2018 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 动态分析为检验这些标签提供了有用的基础。 源代码和补丁分析可以识别可疑缺陷并指导测试，而执行测试则验证具体输入是否能到达相关操作并产生可观察的故障。 一个与机制相适应的判官，结合覆盖率和归因证据，可以将该故障与已标记的功能关联起来。 在修复版本上重播相同条件，可以检验修复是否改变了观察到的行为（Hazimeh 等，2020；Barr 等，2015；Mei 等，2026）。 例如，内存仪器化可以暴露无效访问，而授权和资源故障则需要与它们的安全后果相匹配的判官。 归因必须将观察到的故障与已标记的功能关联起来，并且测试框架必须保留相关的防护和调用条件。 这些要求有助于区分历史代码中的缺陷与测试引入的故障（第 2.3 节）。 证据的范围与其存在同样重要：搜索失败可能反映覆盖不完整、输入有限或判官不合适，因此未能触发缺陷本身并不能作为标记为“非易受攻击”的依据（Klees 等，2018）。

sents.zh: 归因必须将观察到的故障与已标记的功能关联起来，并且测试框架必须保留相关的防护和调用条件。

sents.en: These requirements help distinguish a defect in the historical code from a failure introduced by the test (Section 2.3 ).

sents.en: The scope of the evidence matters as much as its presence: an unsuccessful search may reflect incomplete coverage, limited inputs, or an unsuitable oracle, so failure to trigger a defect is not by itself grounds for a non-vulnerable label ( Klees et al., 2018 ) .
sents.zh: 证据的范围与其存在同样重要：搜索失败可能反映覆盖不完整、输入有限或判官不合适，因此未能触发缺陷本身并不能作为标记为“非易受攻击”的依据（Klees 等，2018）。

paragraphs.en: A major practical obstacle is the cost of obtaining faithful executions at scale. Commit mining provides candidate labels cheaply, while validating each function requires mechanism-specific investigation and execution. Each historical instance may require recovering source revisions, resolving dependencies, constructing a harness, and finding an input that reaches the suspected mechanism. Google’s OSS-Fuzz documentation notes that writing fuzz targets typically requires several hours of manual work and project knowledge. Its account of LLM-based target generation reports runtime coverage of about 30% for many integrated projects ( Google Open Source Security Team, 2023 ) . ARVO further shows that rebuilding historical programs remains difficult even when a triggering input is already available ( Mei et al., 2026 ) . These costs help explain why prior label audits often examined samples of 50 to 100 functions per dataset ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Croft et al., 2023 ; Risse et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 一个主要的实践障碍是以大规模方式获取忠实执行的成本。 提交挖掘可以廉价地提供候选标签，而验证每个函数则需要针对特定机制的调查和执行。 每个历史实例可能需要恢复源程序修订版本、解决依赖关系、构建测试框架，并找到能够触发可疑机制的输入。 Google 的 OSS-Fuzz 文档指出，编写模糊测试目标通常需要数小时的手动操作和对项目的深入了解。 其关于基于 LLM 的目标生成方法报告称，在许多集成项目中运行时覆盖率达到约 30%（Google Open Source Security Team, 2023）。 ARVO 进一步表明，即使已经获得了触发输入，重建历史程序仍然具有挑战性（Mei et al., 2026）。 这些成本有助于解释为何先前的标签审计通常针对每个数据集检查 50 到 100 个函数的样本（Chen et al., 2023；Croft et al., 2023；Risse et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Recent LLM agents offer an opportunity to automate much of this work. SWE-agent and AutoCodeRover combine repository navigation, code analysis, and tool use to address software tasks ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . In security testing, Google reported 26 previously unknown vulnerabilities found through AI-generated fuzz targets in 2024 ( Google, 2024 ) . DARPA’s 2025 AI Cyber Challenge reported that autonomous systems found 54 synthetic vulnerabilities and patched 43 across challenges spanning 54 million lines of code ( Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, 2025 ) . These results motivate using agents to construct and refine experiments from execution feedback. Agents can adjust build commands, prepare harnesses, and revise inputs when an attempt fails to reach the target. Their explanations still require supporting source and runtime observations before they can justify a dataset label.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的 LLM 智能体为自动化处理这类工作的很大一部分提供了机会。 SWE-agent 和 AutoCodeRover 将仓库导航、代码分析和工具使用相结合，以解决软件任务（Yang et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2024）。 在安全测试中，Google 报告称，2024 年通过人工智能生成的模糊测试目标发现了 26 个此前未知的安全漏洞（Google, 2024）。 DARPA 的 2025 年人工智能网络挑战赛报告称，自主系统在涵盖 5400 万行代码的挑战中发现了 54 个合成漏洞，并修复了其中 43 个（Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, 2025）。 这些结果促使人们利用智能体根据执行反馈来构建和迭代实验。 当尝试未能达到目标时，智能体可以调整构建命令、准备测试框架并修改输入。 在能够为一个数据集标签提供合理解释之前，它们的解释仍需有源代码和运行时观察结果的支持。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches address different parts of this problem. D2A labels static-analysis findings, and CleanVul uses LLM-based heuristics to identify vulnerability-related function changes ( Zheng et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . ARVO automates reproduction of historical vulnerabilities from OSS-Fuzz and supplies executable environments ( Mei et al., 2026 ) . CVE-Factory already combines agents with dynamic execution to construct vulnerability tasks and assess source authenticity and repair validity ( Luo et al., 2026 ) . VulTrigger uses multiple agents to generate downstream tests for third-party library vulnerabilities ( JU et al., 2026 ) . Our focus is auditing existing function labels in BigVul, PrimeVul, and DiverseVul, then examining detector performance under the resulting corrections. This requires connecting runtime observations to the particular labelled function and defining how confirmation, label correction, and unresolved attempts follow from the available evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法解决了该问题的不同部分。 D2A 为静态分析结果添加标签，而 CleanVul 则使用基于大语言模型的经验法则来识别与漏洞相关的函数变化（Zheng 等人，2021；Li 等人，2024）。 ARVO 可自动重现来自 OSS-Fuzz 的历史漏洞，并提供可执行环境（Mei 等人，2026）。 CVE-Factory 已将智能体与动态执行相结合，用于构建漏洞任务，并评估源代码的真实性和修复的有效性（Luo 等人，2026）。 VulTrigger 使用多个智能体为第三方库的漏洞生成下游测试（JU 等人，2026）。 我们的重点是审计 BigVul、PrimeVul 和 DiverseVul 中现有的函数标签，然后检验检测器在由此产生的修正下的性能表现。 这需要将运行时观察结果与特定的已标记函数关联起来，并明确如何根据可用证据进行确认、标签修正以及处理未解决的尝试。

paragraphs.en: We introduce VulValidate , a workflow that uses LLM agents to orchestrate dynamic analysis tools for reproducible function-level label auditing. Starting from historical source and the listed fixing commit, the agent analyzes the mechanism, selects tools and an execution route, constructs and refines triggering inputs, and performs controlled executions of vulnerable and fixed revisions. Function execution, oracle relevance, and causal attribution determine what the observations support. Label correction requires an attack satisfying seven evidence checks and a source-grounded explanation rejecting the original attribution under the tested conditions (Section 2.5 ). Source bindings, inputs, logs, return codes, coverage, and attack histories support replay and inspection. Instances with insufficient evidence retain an explicit unresolved outcome. The workflow separates defect existence, correspondence to the listed CVE, and repair effectiveness, with function-level attribution required to assess the dataset label.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 VulValidate，一种工作流程，它利用 LLM 智能体来协调动态分析工具，以实现可复现的函数级标签审计。 从历史源代码和列出的修复提交开始，该智能体会分析其机制、选择工具和执行路线、构建并优化触发输入，并对存在漏洞和已修复的版本进行受控执行。 函数执行、预言机相关性和因果归因决定了观察结果所支持的内容。 标签修正需要一次攻击满足七项证据检查，并提供一个基于源代码的解释，以在测试条件下否定最初的归因（第 2.5 节）。 源代码绑定、输入、日志、返回代码、覆盖率和攻击历史支持重演和检查。 证据不足的实例将保留明确的未解决结果。 该工作流程将缺陷存在性、与所列 CVE 的对应关系以及修复有效性分离开来，并且需要函数级归因来评估数据集的标签。

paragraphs.en: We apply VulValidate to all 35,849 instances originally labelled vulnerable in BigVul, PrimeVul, and DiverseVul. The audit yields 20,510 confirmations, 6,819 label-correction decisions, 7,981 attacked but undecided instances, and 539 instances that were not successfully measured. Two of the authors, each with vulnerability-detection experience, blinded to the agent’s decisions, each reviewed the same 581 instances, randomly sampled within each dataset and initial S6 outcome group; their consensus supports 90.0% to 92.0% of sampled confirmations and 92.6% to 99.0% of sampled label corrections (Section 4.2 ), and agreement with independently produced manual labels yields Cohen’s κ \kappa values ( Cohen, 1960 ) from 0.36 to 0.55, providing an external reference for the audit decisions. (Section 4.1 ). The corrected datasets retain confirmed and corrected instances whose decisions survive review, and exclude unresolved instances and unresolved label conflicts (Section 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 VulValidate 应用于 BigVul、PrimeVul 和 DiverseVul 中最初被标记为存在漏洞的全部 35,849 个实例。 此次审计产生了 20,510 项确认结果、6,819 项标签修正决策、7,981 个受到攻击但尚未定论的实例，以及 539 个未能成功测量的实例。 两位作者均有漏洞检测经验，且对智能体的决策不知情。他们各自审查了相同的 581 个实例，这些实例从每个数据集和初始 S6 结果组中随机抽取；他们的共识支持了 90.0% 至 92.0% 的抽样确认结果以及 92.6% 至 99.0% 的抽样标签修正（第 4.2 节），与独立生成的手动标签的一致性则产生了 Cohen’s κ \kappa 值（Cohen, 1960），范围从 0.36 到 0.55，为审计决策提供了外部参考。（第 4.1 节） 修正后的数据集保留了经审核确认且决策有效的已确认和已修正实例，同时排除了未解决的实例和未解决的标签冲突（第 3.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: The model experiments distinguish re-evaluation from retraining. With model parameters held fixed, corrected evaluation protocols lower F1 for all five detectors on BigVul and DiverseVul, with absolute decreases of 0.0403 to 0.2737 and 0.0532 to 0.0888, respectively. On corrected test labels, the completed retraining runs achieve higher F1 for four of five detectors on each dataset (Section 4.4 ). The merged benchmark further provides a post-correction evaluation of graph-based and transformer-based detectors, connecting label auditing to the interpretation of model performance.
paragraphs.zh: 该模型实验区分了重新评估与重新训练。 在模型参数保持固定的情况下，修正后的评估协议使 BigVul 和 DiverseVul 上所有五个检测器的 F1 值均有所下降，绝对降幅分别为 0.0403 至 0.2737 以及 0.0532 至 0.0888。 在修正后的测试标签上，完成重新训练的模型在每个数据集上使五个检测器中的四个实现了更高的 F1 值（第 4.4 节）。 合并后的基准测试还进一步提供了对图基和 Transformer 基检测器的修正后评估，将标签审计与模型性能的解读联系起来。

paragraphs.en: The study addresses one design question and three empirical questions:
paragraphs.zh: 本研究探讨了一个设计问题以及三个经验性问题：

paragraphs.en: How do LLM agents construct reproducible dynamic experiments to audit function-level vulnerability labels?
paragraphs.zh: LLM 智能体如何构建可重复的动态实验，以审计函数级别的漏洞标签？

paragraphs.en: What are the results of manually reviewing the agents’ audit decisions?
paragraphs.zh: 手动审查智能体的审计决策会产生哪些结果？

paragraphs.en: What are the distributions of audit outcomes across BigVul, PrimeVul, and DiverseVul?
paragraphs.zh: BigVul、PrimeVul 和 DiverseVul 中审计结果的分布情况如何？

paragraphs.en: What changes in vulnerability detector performance are observed after label correction?
paragraphs.zh: 标签校正后，漏洞检测器的性能发生了哪些变化？

paragraphs.en: Improving label quality for three widely used datasets. We provide an audit of the complete populations originally labelled vulnerable in BigVul, PrimeVul, and DiverseVul, together with corrected data constructed through label adjudication, manual-review filtering, conflict resolution, and deduplication. Original labels, audit outcomes, supporting evidence, and unresolved instances remain available for inspection. This supports reuse of the corrected data while preserving the conditions under which each label was assessed.
paragraphs.zh: 提升三个广泛使用的数据集的标签质量。 我们对 BigVul、PrimeVul 和 DiverseVul 中最初被标记为存在漏洞的全部样本进行了审核，同时提供了通过标签裁定、人工审查过滤、冲突解决和去重构建的修正数据。 原始标签、审核结果、支持证据以及未解决的实例均可供查阅。 这既支持对修正数据的再利用，也保留了每个标签评估时所依据的条件。

paragraphs.en: Agentic dynamic validation of historical vulnerability labels. VulValidate combines historical reconstruction, feedback-guided trigger construction, controlled execution, and function-level attribution under an explicit evidence contract. The operational prompt, tool and oracle rules, and evidence requirements form a reusable skill for auditing additional vulnerability instances.
paragraphs.zh: 对历史漏洞标签的智能体动态验证。 VulValidate 在明确的证据契约框架下，整合了历史重建、反馈引导的触发器构建、受控执行以及函数级归因。 操作提示、工具与神谕规则以及证据要求共同构成了一项可复用的技能，用于审计额外的漏洞实例。

paragraphs.en: A reproducible vulnerability evidence corpus. This resource supports vulnerability detection, localization, repair evaluation, and further label review.

paragraphs.en: VulValidate audits a labelled function using historical source, vulnerability metadata, and a listed fixing commit. Figure 1 summarizes six stages: reconstruction and planning (S1–S2), feedback-guided trigger construction (S3), controlled execution and attribution (S4), evidence preservation and cold replay (S5), and adjudication (S6). Retained source and runtime evidence determine whether the original attribution is supported, rejected within the tested mechanism, or unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: VulValidate 使用历史源代码、漏洞元数据和已列出的修复提交记录来审计一个带标签的函数。 图 1 总结了六个阶段：重建与规划（S1–S2）、反馈引导的触发器构建（S3）、受控执行与归因（S4）、证据保留与冷重演（S5），以及裁决（S6）。 保留的源代码和运行时证据将决定原始归因是否得到支持、在受测机制中被拒绝，或无法确定。

sents.en: Figure 1 summarizes six stages: reconstruction and planning (S1–S2), feedback-guided trigger construction (S3), controlled execution and attribution (S4), evidence preservation and cold replay (S5), and adjudication (S6).

paragraphs.en: S1 reconstructs a historical testbed and S2 specifies how to exercise it, following the reconstruction requirements that ARVO and CVE-Factory established for executable vulnerability reproduction ( Mei et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: S1 重建了一个历史测试环境，而 S2 则根据 ARVO 和 CVE-Factory 为可执行漏洞复现所制定的重建要求，明确了如何对该环境进行测试（Mei 等人，2026；Luo 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: S1: Reconstruct the historical target and execution environment. Using the listed fixing commit, VulValidate locates the upstream repository, verifies the commit against repository history and the vulnerability metadata, and takes its parent as the initial vulnerable revision. Let f D f_{D} denote the dataset function body, f v f_{v} the corresponding function at the verified vulnerable revision, and f f f_{f} its counterpart at the fixed revision. The label attached to f D f_{D} is audited on f v f_{v} and f f f_{f} ; the repository, exact commits, file and function extent, and fixing diff are recorded as source bindings. Environment reconstruction follows standard practice for historical builds: the source tree, dependencies, toolchain, and platform are recovered from the repository and its metadata, in Docker containers where the user-space environment can be reproduced directly and in virtual machines where kernel or platform requirements need stronger isolation ( Merkel, 2014 ; Bellard, 2005 ; Kivity et al., 2007 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 重建历史目标与执行环境。 使用所列的修复提交，VulValidate 定位上游仓库，验证该提交与仓库历史记录及漏洞元数据的一致性，并将其父提交作为初始的易受攻击版本。 令 f D f_{D} 表示数据集函数体，f v f_{v} 表示在已验证的易受攻击版本中的对应函数，而 f f f_{f} 表示其在修复版本中的对应函数。 附加在 f D f_{D} 上的标签会在 f v f_{v} 和 f f f_{f} 上进行审核；仓库、具体提交、文件和函数范围以及修复差异将被记录为源绑定。 环境重建遵循历史构建的标准实践：从仓库及其元数据中恢复源树、依赖项、工具链和平台，在 Docker 容器中可以直接重现用户空间环境，而在虚拟机中则需要更强的隔离以满足内核或平台要求（Merkel, 2014；Bellard, 2005；Kivity et al., 2007）。

sents.zh: 重建历史目标与执行环境。

VulValidate compares f D f_{D} with f v f_{v} for identity, extent, and completeness; if f D f_{D} is incomplete, the experiment uses the verified historical function and records the discrepancy.

paragraphs.en: S2: Analyze the vulnerability mechanism and plan the experiment. The agent analyzes the fixing diff, f v f_{v} , f f f_{f} , callers and callees, and the CVE and CWE metadata, with verified source as the primary basis when metadata is missing or inconsistent. The plan records a root-cause hypothesis, the attacker- or environment-controlled precondition, the disputed operation or branch, the entry point, the execution route, and the tools and oracle selected for the mechanism (Section 2.2 ); Section 2.6 shows one such plan.
paragraphs.zh: S2：分析漏洞机制并规划实验。 智能体会分析修复差异 f v f_{v}、f f f_{f}、调用者和被调用者，以及 CVE 和 CWE 元数据；当元数据缺失或不一致时，以经过验证的来源为主要依据。 该计划会记录根本原因假设、攻击者或环境控制的先决条件、存在争议的操作或分支、入口点、执行路径，以及为分析该机制而选择的工具和预言机（第 2.2 节）；第 2.6 节展示了其中一个此类计划。

paragraphs.en: Two execution routes are available. The full-project route builds the historical project and exercises a public interface that reaches the labelled function in its real program context ( Mei et al., 2026 ; Google, 2026 ) . When this is infeasible, the extracted-function route compiles the real target with its mechanism-relevant types, guards, callees, and calling conditions behind a harness; stubs may replace unavailable services only while preserving these conditions. The route fixes the evidence scope: full-project execution supports reachability and comparison across revisions, but when a fixing commit changes several functions, a difference between revisions establishes repair-associated behavior and attribution to the labelled function requires further evidence; extracted-function execution isolates the target by varying it while holding harness, input, and context fixed. The route and reconstructed context are recorded for S4.
paragraphs.zh: 有两种执行路线可供选择。 完整项目路线会构建历史项目，并调用一个公共接口，该接口在其真实程序上下文中能够访问到带标签的函数（Mei et al., 2026；Google, 2026）。 当此方法不可行时，提取函数路线会将真实目标与其机制相关的类型、守卫、被调用项以及调用条件置于一个测试框架之后进行编译；仅在这些条件得以保留的前提下，占位程序可以替代无法使用的服务。 该路线明确了证据范围：完整项目执行支持跨版本的可达性分析和比较，但当修复提交修改了多个函数时，版本间的差异只能确定与修复相关的行为，而要将行为归因于带标签的函数，则需要更多证据；提取函数执行则通过改变目标函数本身，同时保持测试框架、输入和上下文不变，从而将目标孤立出来。 路线和重建的上下文已为 S4 记录在案。

paragraphs.en: S3 repeatedly executes attack attempts against the vulnerable side using the S2 plan, historical source, dataset metadata, fixing diff, prior attack history, and build information. Runtime observations guide changes to inputs, harnesses, execution state, tools, or routes.
paragraphs.zh: S3 使用 S2 计划、历史源、数据集元数据、修复差异、过往攻击历史和构建信息，对脆弱方重复执行攻击尝试。 运行时观察结果会引导输入、容器、执行状态、工具或路线的变更。

paragraphs.en: The study uses Claude Code as the execution controller ( Anthropic, 2026a ; Anthropic, 2026b ) , with model and thinking-effort settings in Section 3.1 . It navigates repositories, edits files, executes commands, and operates analysis tools, following capabilities demonstrated by repository agents ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . CVE-Factory constructs executable vulnerability tasks, VulTrigger generates downstream tests, and OSS-Fuzz agents operate in build and test environments ( Luo et al., 2026 ; JU et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . An operational prompt defines source rules, route preferences, tool and oracle requirements, evidence layout, outcome criteria, and stopping conditions. The prompt constrains the evidence rather than the controller, so another model can run the same loop against the same requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究使用 Claude Code 作为执行控制器（Anthropic，2026a；Anthropic，2026b），其模型和思维努力设置见第 3.1 节。 它能浏览代码库、编辑文件、执行命令并操作分析工具，这些能力均遵循代码库智能体所展现的功能（Yang 等，2024；Zhang 等，2024；Jimenez 等，2024）。 CVE-Factory 构建可执行的漏洞任务，VulTrigger 生成下游测试，而 OSS-Fuzz 智能体则在构建和测试环境中运行（Luo 等，2026；JU 等，2026；Zhang 等，2026）。 一个操作提示定义了源规则、路线偏好、工具与预言机要求、证据布局、结果标准以及停止条件。 该提示约束的是证据而非控制器，因此另一个模型也可以针对相同要求运行相同的循环流程。

paragraphs.en: Tool selection follows the suspected mechanism and relies on standard dynamic analysis tools: sanitizers for memory, uninitialized-value, arithmetic, leak, and concurrency errors (ASan/KASAN, MSan/KMSAN, UBSan, LSan, TSan/KCSAN, and Memcheck) ( Serebryany et al., 2012 ; Linux Kernel Documentation, 2026a ; Stepanov and Serebryany, 2015 ; Linux Kernel Documentation, 2026c ; LLVM Project, 2026b ; LLVM Project, 2026a ; Serebryany and Iskhodzhanov, 2009 ; Linux Kernel Documentation, 2026b ; Nethercote and Seward, 2007 ) ; progress, termination, and resource observations for denial of service; security-decision, state, or output oracles for authorization, injection, and state-machine defects ( Barr et al., 2015 ) ; and coverage and debugger traces for execution and attribution evidence ( Hazimeh et al., 2020 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 工具选择遵循推测的机制，并依赖标准的动态分析工具：用于检测内存、未初始化值、算术运算、泄漏和并发错误的清理工具（ASan/KASAN、MSan/KMSAN、UBSan、LSan、TSan/KCSAN 和 Memcheck）（Serebryany 等人，2012；Linux 内核文档，2026a；Stepanov 和 Serebryany，2015；Linux 内核文档，2026c；LLVM 项目，2026b；LLVM 项目，2026a；Serebryany 和 Iskhodzhanov，2009；Linux 内核文档，2026b；Nethercote 和 Seward，2007）；用于拒绝服务攻击的进度、终止和资源观察；用于授权、注入和状态机缺陷的安全决策、状态或输出神谕（Barr 等人，2015）；以及用于执行和归因证据的覆盖率和调试器跟踪（Hazimeh 等人，2020）。

paragraphs.en: The controller runs a feedback-guided loop in the style of greybox and sanitizer-guided fuzzing ( Fioraldi et al., 2020 ; Böhme et al., 2017 ; Österlund et al., 2020 ; Meng et al., 2024 ) . Each iteration instantiates the S2 hypothesis with a route, entry point, tools, oracle, and required state; constructs or modifies an input, schedule, or harness while preserving the calling conditions identified in S2; builds the pinned vulnerable environment with the selected instrumentation and executes it under documented resource limits; and collects oracle output, coverage, traces, and return status. Following Magma ( Hazimeh et al., 2020 ) , the observations are read at three levels: function entry establishes reachability, coverage or tracing establishes execution of the disputed operation or branch, and the oracle establishes a security-relevant violation. The gap determines the next refinement: an unreached function revises the input or entry path, an unexecuted disputed operation revises the triggering condition, harness, or state, and an inadequate observation revises the tools or oracle. When a trigger succeeds, the exact input, harness, source and environment bindings, commands, logs, and coverage are frozen for two-side replay in S4; unsuccessful attempts are kept with their conditions, scope, and stopping reason, since they document the search scope that check 5 of Table 1 requires. The loop ends when sufficient evidence is obtained or a predefined stopping condition is reached. Tool selection rules, the full step list, and stopping conditions are given in Supplementary Section S2.
paragraphs.zh: 控制器以灰盒和消毒剂引导的模糊测试（Fioraldi 等人，2020；Böhme 等人，2017；Österlund 等人，2020；Meng 等人，2024）风格运行一个反馈引导循环。 每次迭代都会使用一条路线、一个入口点、工具、预言机和所需状态来实例化 S2 假设；在保持 S2 中识别的调用条件的同时构建或修改输入、调度程序或测试框架；使用选定的仪器构建固定的易受攻击环境，并在已记录的资源限制下执行它；然后收集预言机输出、覆盖信息、追踪和返回状态。 遵循 Magma（Hazimeh 等人，2020）的方法，观察在三个层级上进行读取：函数入口确定可达性，覆盖或追踪确定争议操作或分支的执行情况，而预言机则确定与安全相关的违规。 该差距决定了下一步的优化：未达到的函数会修改输入或入口路径，未执行的争议操作会修改触发条件、测试框架或状态，而不充分的观察则会修改工具或预言机。 当触发成功时，确切的输入、测试框架、源代码和环境绑定、命令、日志和覆盖信息会被冻结，以便在 S4 中进行双方面重演；未成功的尝试也会保留其条件、范围和停止原因，因为它们记录了表 1 中检查 5 所要求的搜索范围。 当获得足够证据或达到预定义的停止条件时，循环结束。 工具选择规则、完整的步骤列表和停止条件见补充材料第 S2 节。

paragraphs.en: S5 organizes the evidence and attack history collected throughout the workflow into replayable packages. paragraphs.en: Before an experiment is treated as reproducible, the workflow attempts a cold replay. For containerized experiments, replay runs in a fresh container without access to the original workspace. Generated build products are removed before rebuilding from the retained source and inputs. Original evidence remains unchanged, with new replay outputs stored separately for comparison. Source and binary identities, oracle observations, and evidence-file hashes are checked. Build information identifies the repository, revision, compiler, dependencies, settings, and local modifications. Experiments requiring specific kernels, devices, or virtual machines document these additional requirements, consistent with S1.
paragraphs.zh: 在将某项实验视为可重复之前，工作流会尝试进行冷重演。 对于容器化的实验，重演会在一个全新的容器中运行，且无法访问原始工作区。 在基于保留的源代码和输入重新构建之前，已生成的构建产物会被移除。 原始证据保持不变，而新的重演输出则被单独存储以便进行比较。 系统会检查源代码与二进制文件的身份标识、预言机观察结果以及证据文件的哈希值。 构建信息用于识别代码库、版本、编译器、依赖项、设置以及本地修改内容。 需要特定内核、设备或虚拟机的实验，其额外要求应与 S1 保持一致并予以记录。

sents.en: Before an experiment is treated as reproducible, the workflow attempts a cold replay.
sents.zh: 在将某项实验视为可重复之前，工作流会尝试进行冷重演。

sents.en: For containerized experiments, replay runs in a fresh container without access to the original workspace.
sents.zh: 对于容器化的实验，重演会在一个全新的容器中运行，且无法访问原始工作区。

sents.en: Generated build products are removed before rebuilding from the retained source and inputs.
sents.zh: 在基于保留的源代码和输入重新构建之前，已生成的构建产物会被移除。

sents.en: Original evidence remains unchanged, with new replay outputs stored separately for comparison.
sents.zh: 原始证据保持不变，而新的重演输出则被单独存储以便进行比较。

sents.en: Source and binary identities, oracle observations, and evidence-file hashes are checked.
sents.zh: 系统会检查源代码与二进制文件的身份标识、预言机观察结果以及证据文件的哈希值。

sents.en: Build information identifies the repository, revision, compiler, dependencies, settings, and local modifications.
sents.zh: 构建信息用于识别代码库、版本、编译器、依赖项、设置以及本地修改内容。

sents.en: Experiments requiring specific kernels, devices, or virtual machines document these additional requirements, consistent with S1.
sents.zh: 需要特定内核、设备或虚拟机的实验，其额外要求应与 S1 保持一致并予以记录。

paragraphs.en: A complete package does not by itself establish a label: manual review (Section 3.2 ) examines the claimed defect and function attribution, the harness’s calling conditions, and the source reasoning behind a label correction. The supplementary artifact provides the prompt or skill, field definitions, route and oracle rules, package layout, stopping conditions, and integrity requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 一个完整的包本身并不能确立标签：人工审查（第 3.2 节）会检查所声称的缺陷和功能归属、线束的调用条件，以及标签修正背后的来源推理。 补充工件提供了提示或技能、字段定义、路由和神谕规则、包布局、停止条件以及完整性要求。

paragraphs.en: S6 assigns four outcomes from the retained evidence. A qualifying target-attributed witness supports confirmation; otherwise, a supported rejection of the original attribution supports label correction. Unresolved outcomes depend on whether a usable dynamic observation exists.

paragraphs.en: Confirmed. Confirmation requires executing the complete, source-bound historical function on the dataset-labelled side under a saved input or runtime condition. The driver preserves relevant types, guards, and calling contracts. A mechanism-appropriate oracle must identify a real defect or security-relevant violation causally linked to the function (Section 2.3 ). A valid witness supports confirmation despite a CVE mismatch or persistence on the comparison side. Source authenticity, dynamic execution, and repair validity remain separate claims ( Luo et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 已确认。 确认需要在保存的输入或运行时条件下，在带有数据集标签的一侧执行完整的、与源绑定的历史函数。 驱动程序会保留相关的类型、守护程序和调用契约。 必须通过一种机制合适的预言机，识别出与该函数存在因果关联的真实缺陷或与安全相关的违规问题（第 2.3 节）。 即使比较一侧存在 CVE 不匹配或持久性问题，有效的见证也能支持确认。 源代码的真实性、动态执行和修复的有效性仍然是相互独立的论断（Luo 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: S3. Three rounds are retained. The first compiled a harness whose own body performed the store; ASan fired, but its frame #0 lay in the harness file, no library code ran, and there was no fixed side, so the record marks the attempt superseded and keeps it. The second wrote an end mark past each truncated output capacity, across levels 1–19 and 40 input shapes, to find a capacity at which the compressed offset table ends exactly on the buffer’s last byte. The third fixed the input to 40 records whose equal match lengths make upstream choose set_rle at that capacity, so the match-length table is entered with dstCapacity == 0 .

paragraphs.en: S4. Replayed on both revisions with the same driver, input and limits, the vulnerable side exits 1 with an ASan WRITE of size one “0 bytes to the right” of the 192-byte destination while the fixed side exits 0 returning dstSize_tooSmall . Frame #0 identifies the disputed store in ZSTD_buildCTable , and frames #1–#10 show the executed call path from ZSTD_compress . Adding the capacity check in ZSTD_buildCTable removes the observed write. Following Section 2.3 , function-level attribution depends on mechanism-specific source and runtime evidence; a caller’s presence in the stack alone is insufficient for attribution. paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ1. LLM agents construct reproducible experiments by linking historical reconstruction and planning to feedback-guided attacks, controlled two-side execution, and function-level attribution. Each decision is bound to retained source, inputs, logs, and coverage that replay in a fresh container, and the S6 contract, not the agent’s explanation, decides the outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 对研究问题1的解答。 LLM智能体通过将历史重建与规划同反馈引导的攻击、受控的双边执行以及函数级归因相连接，构建可复现的实验。 每个决策都与保留的来源、输入、日志和覆盖范围相关联，这些内容会在新的容器中重新运行；而S6合同而非智能体的解释决定了最终结果。

paragraphs.en: The audit covers 35,849 instances originally labelled vulnerable: 10,900 from BigVul, 6,004 from PrimeVul, and 18,945 from the official DiverseVul collection ( Fan et al., 2020 ; Ding et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . Each instance is a labelled function and receives one of the four S6 outcomes (Section 2.5 ); reported outcome distributions incorporate the manual-review results, and the initial agent decisions are retained for the review comparison (Section 3.2 ). The agent was Claude Opus 5.0 run through Claude Code with thinking effort set to high throughout S1 to S6; it reconstructed programs, executed attacks, preserved evidence, and assigned outcomes under the S6 criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 此次审计涵盖了最初被标记为存在漏洞的 35,849 个实例：其中 10,900 个来自 BigVul，6,004 个来自 PrimeVul，另有 18,945 个来自官方 DiverseVul 数据集（Fan et al., 2020；Ding et al., 2024；Chen et al., 2023）。 每个实例都是一个带有标签的函数，并获得了 S6 中的四种结果之一（第 2.5 节）；所报告的结果分布包含了人工审查的结果，而智能体的初始决策则被保留下来用于与审查结果进行比较（第 3.2 节）。 在 S1 到 S6 的整个过程中，该智能体为 Claude Opus 5.0，通过 Claude Code 运行，并将思考强度设为高；它能够重构程序、执行攻击、保存证据，并根据 S6 标准分配结果。

paragraphs.en: Blinded two-expert review. Two of the authors, each with vulnerability-detection experience, each reviewed all 581 selected instances using a common checklist. The agent’s decisions were withheld throughout individual assessment and consensus discussion. Reviewers examined source code, inputs, harnesses, runtime logs, and attribution evidence to form their own judgments under the S6 criteria. Each instance received two individual assessments, and disagreements were resolved through discussion to obtain one final consensus assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 双专家盲审。 两位作者均有漏洞检测经验，他们各自使用一份通用检查表，对全部 581 个选定实例进行了审查。 在整个个人评估和共识讨论过程中，智能体的决策均未透露。 评审人员依据 S6 标准，通过检查源代码、输入、测试框架、运行时日志和归因证据来形成自己的判断。 每个实例都获得了两次独立评估，并通过讨论解决分歧，最终得出一个共识性评估结果。

paragraphs.en: Comparison with independent manual labels. The review above used this project’s reviewers and criteria. As an external check, we compare the agent’s decisions with manual labels produced independently by two prior studies. Risse et al. ( Risse et al., 2025 ) relabelled 100 BigVul and 100 DiverseVul functions, judging whether each function is vulnerable. Croft et al. ( Croft et al., 2023 ) checked 70 BigVul functions, all among Risse et al.’s 100, judging whether each label is accurate. BigVul functions are joined by row number, which is also our instance identifier, and DiverseVul functions by index and function-text hash; all 270 join. Confirmed counts as the label standing and Label correction as rejected; the two unresolved outcomes are not decisions. Each agent decision is read from the campaign’s measurement ledger, which records per function the outcome this campaign’s own runs established and how deep the supporting evidence is, so all four comparisons are on one scale (Supplementary Section S4). We report raw agreement, chance agreement from the marginal rates, and Cohen’s κ \kappa ( Cohen, 1960 ) ; the agreement between the two human studies on their 70 shared functions is the reference. Details and every disagreement are in Supplementary Section S4.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate three graph-based and two transformer-based detectors. Devign uses a gated graph neural network over syntax, control-flow, data-flow, and token-order edges ( Zhou et al., 2019 ) . ReVeal combines a similar encoder with representation learning and class rebalancing ( Chakraborty et al., 2021 ) . DeepDFA embeds abstract dataflow facts over control-flow graphs ( Steenhoek et al., 2024 ) . LineVul fine-tunes encoder-only CodeBERT on function tokens ( Fu and Tantithamthavorn, 2022 ; Feng et al., 2020 ) ; CodeT5 fine-tunes a pretrained encoder–decoder through its defect-detection head ( Wang et al., 2021 ) . Details appear in Supplementary Section S6.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了三种基于图的检测器和两种基于变压器的探测器。 Devign 使用一种门控图神经网络，作用于语法、控制流、数据流和令牌顺序边（Zhou 等人，2019）。 ReVeal 将类似的编码器与表示学习和类别再平衡相结合（Chakraborty 等人，2021）。 DeepDFA 将抽象数据流事实嵌入到控制流图中（Steenhoek 等人，2024）。 LineVul 在函数令牌上对仅包含编码器的 CodeBERT 进行微调（Fu 和 Tantithamthavorn，2022；Feng 等人，2020）；CodeT5 通过其缺陷检测头对预训练的编码器-解码器进行微调（Wang 等人，2021）。 详细信息见补充材料第 S6 节。

paragraphs.en: The agent agrees with Risse et al. on 71 of 92 BigVul functions ( κ = 0.55 \kappa=0.55 ), as closely as the two human studies agree with each other ( κ = 0.55 \kappa=0.55 ), and on 68 of 87 DiverseVul functions ( κ = 0.50 \kappa=0.50 ): moderate agreement on the scale of Landis and Koch ( Landis and Koch, 1977 ) . Seventeen of the 21 disagreements are confirmations that Risse et al. call secure. For seven of them, Risse et al. attribute the reported CVE’s defect to another function in the same commit; for the other ten, they judge the commit not to be a security fix. paragraphs.en: CWE coverage and interpretation. Across both classes of the release, 446,823 instances carry valid CWE annotations spanning 153 categories; 90,768 (16.88%) lack them. Multiple CWEs occur in 51,249 instances, yielding 503,611 instance–CWE associations, each identifier counted once per instance. Among the 15,890 retained vulnerable instances, 14,181 have annotations spanning 145 categories and 1,709 (10.76%) lack them; 2,151 carry multiple CWEs, yielding 16,587 associations. The three largest categories among vulnerable instances, CWE-119, CWE-125, and CWE-787 (Table 5 ), are all memory-safety weaknesses and together cover a third of the vulnerable subset.

sents.en: The three largest categories among vulnerable instances, CWE-119, CWE-125, and CWE-787 (Table 5 ), are all memory-safety weaknesses and together cover a third of the vulnerable subset.

paragraphs.en: Answer to RQ3. The audit yields 20,510 confirmations, 6,819 label corrections, 7,981 attacked-but-undecided instances, and 539 that were not successfully measured. paragraphs.en: Class imbalance and implications for RQ4. Accuracy above 0.96 for the transformer models reflects the 97.04% non-vulnerable majority, not detection: the best detector, CodeT5, finds 39.66% of the vulnerable functions, and 44.71% of its positive predictions are correct. The merged benchmark removes the contradictory supervision described in the Introduction; on it, CodeT5 leads on F1, MCC, and AUROC, and every detector leaves most vulnerable functions undetected.

paragraphs.en: Construct. Confirmed asserts an attributed defect in the historical function under the chosen oracle, not that it is the CVE’s defect, that the fix removes it, or that an attacker can reach it (Section 2.5 ); this is where the agent and Risse et al. part ways (Section 4.1 ). Label correction maps to evidence-supported empirical non-vulnerable labels ( y = 0 y=0 ) under all seven checks, source-grounded rejection rationale R R , and the retention policy (Section 3.3 ). Blinded review supported 272/281 sampled initial corrections (96.8%; Table 3(b) ). This pooled sample support rate does not estimate residual vulnerability prevalence; undetected defects may still cause mislabelling.

paragraphs.en: Vulnerability datasets and label quality. BigVul and DiverseVul derive function labels from historical vulnerabilities and fixing commits ( Fan et al., 2020 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . PrimeVul improves labelling and evaluation procedures ( Ding et al., 2024 ) . CVEfixes collects vulnerabilities and fixes, while D2A derives labels through differential static analysis ( Bhandari et al., 2021 ; Zheng et al., 2021 ) . Croft et al. examine label accuracy and duplication, and Risse et al. identify incorrect fixing commits and unrelated changes ( Croft et al., 2023 ; Risse et al., 2025 ) . CleanVul uses LLM-based filtering of vulnerability-fixing commits ( Li et al., 2024 ) . VulValidate complements these approaches with dynamic evidence for function-level label correction and conflict resolution, while retaining unresolved instances.
paragraphs.zh: 漏洞数据集与标签质量。 BigVul 和 DiverseVul 从历史漏洞及修复提交中获取函数标签（Fan et al., 2020；Chen et al., 2023）。 PrimeVul 改进了标签标注与评估流程（Ding et al., 2024）。 CVEfixes 收集漏洞与修复，而 D2A 通过差异静态分析获取标签（Bhandari et al., 2021；Zheng et al., 2021）。 Croft 等人研究了标签的准确性与重复问题，Risse 等人则识别了错误的修复提交及无关变更（Croft et al., 2023；Risse et al., 2025）。 CleanVul 采用基于大语言模型的漏洞修复提交过滤方法（Li et al., 2024）。 VulValidate 通过动态证据为函数级标签的修正与冲突解决提供了补充，同时保留了未解决的实例。

paragraphs.en: Executable vulnerability reproduction and evidence. ARVO reconstructs historical OSS-Fuzz vulnerabilities, replays triggering inputs on vulnerable and fixed revisions, locates repairs, and provides reusable environments ( Mei et al., 2026 ) . CVE-Factory constructs executable vulnerability tasks and evaluates source authenticity, dynamic execution, and repair validity ( Luo et al., 2026 ) . Magma distinguishes reaching, triggering, and detecting defects ( Hazimeh et al., 2020 ) , while fuzzing studies explain how unsuccessful searches depend on inputs, budgets, and randomness ( Klees et al., 2018 ) . VulValidate binds the tested function to historical source, checks execution of the relevant operation, and establishes function-level attribution. Label correction requires mechanism-relevant evidence and a source-grounded rejection rationale, with attack histories preserving the tested scope.
paragraphs.zh: 可执行的漏洞复现与证据。 ARVO 重建历史 OSS-Fuzz 漏洞，在易受攻击和已修复的版本中重放触发输入，定位修复点，并提供可重复使用的环境（Mei 等，2026）。 CVE-Factory 构建可执行的漏洞任务，并评估源代码的真实性、动态执行以及修复的有效性（Luo 等，2026）。 Magma 能够区分缺陷的到达、触发和检测过程（Hazimeh 等，2020），而模糊测试研究则解释了未成功的搜索如何依赖于输入、预算和随机性（Klees 等，2018）。 VulValidate 将受测函数与历史源代码绑定，检查相关操作的执行过程，并建立函数级别的归因。 标签修正需要与机制相关的证据以及基于源代码的拒绝理由，同时攻击历史记录必须保留受测范围。

Devign and ReVeal learn graph-based representations, while DeepDFA uses abstract dataflow information ( Zhou et al., 2019 ; Chakraborty et al., 2021 ; Steenhoek et al., 2024 ) . Empirical studies examine how data quality and experimental choices affect detector performance ( Jimenez et al., 2019 ; Nong et al., 2022 ; Steenhoek et al., 2023 ) . Our experiments distinguish re-evaluation without retraining from retraining with corrected labels. The corrected merged benchmark extends evaluation to combined data after resolving identified label conflicts.

paragraphs.en: VulValidate uses LLM agents to audit function-level vulnerability labels through reproducible dynamic experiments. It combines historical source reconstruction, feedback-guided trigger construction, mechanism-specific oracles, and controlled execution of vulnerable and fixed revisions with function-level attribution. The audit covers 35,849 instances originally labelled vulnerable in BigVul, PrimeVul, and DiverseVul, yielding 20,510 confirmations and 6,819 label corrections and leaving 8,520 instances unresolved. The release contains 15,890 distinct confirmed vulnerable function bodies after byte-exact deduplication. The merged benchmark resolves identified label conflicts under the construction policy and provides more consistent training and evaluation data.
paragraphs.zh: VulValidate 利用 LLM 智能体，通过可重复的动态实验来审计函数级别的漏洞标签。 它结合了历史源代码重构、反馈引导的触发构造、特定机制的预言机，以及对存在漏洞和已修复版本的受控执行，并实现了函数级别的归因分析。 此次审计覆盖了 BigVul、PrimeVul 和 DiverseVul 中最初被标记为存在漏洞的 35,849 个实例，最终确认了 20,510 个案例，修正了 6,819 个标签，另有 8,520 个实例尚未解决。 经过字节级精确去重后，该发布版本包含 15,890 个不同的已确认存在漏洞的函数体。 合并后的基准数据集在构建策略下解决了已识别的标签冲突，并提供了更一致的训练和评估数据。

sents.en: It combines historical source reconstruction, feedback-guided trigger construction, mechanism-specific oracles, and controlled execution of vulnerable and fixed revisions with function-level attribution.
sents.zh: 它结合了历史源代码重构、反馈引导的触发构造、特定机制的预言机，以及对存在漏洞和已修复版本的受控执行，并实现了函数级别的归因分析。

sents.en: The audit covers 35,849 instances originally labelled vulnerable in BigVul, PrimeVul, and DiverseVul, yielding 20,510 confirmations and 6,819 label corrections and leaving 8,520 instances unresolved.
sents.zh: 此次审计覆盖了 BigVul、PrimeVul 和 DiverseVul 中最初被标记为存在漏洞的 35,849 个实例，最终确认了 20,510 个案例，修正了 6,819 个标签，另有 8,520 个实例尚未解决。

sents.en: The release contains 15,890 distinct confirmed vulnerable function bodies after byte-exact deduplication.
sents.zh: 经过字节级精确去重后，该发布版本包含 15,890 个不同的已确认存在漏洞的函数体。

sents.en: The merged benchmark resolves identified label conflicts under the construction policy and provides more consistent training and evaluation data.
sents.zh: 合并后的基准数据集在构建策略下解决了已识别的标签冲突，并提供了更一致的训练和评估数据。

paragraphs.en: Blinded review of 581 randomly sampled instances by two experts supports 90.0% to 92.0% of confirmations and 92.6% to 99.0% of label corrections, and agreement with independently produced manual labels yields Cohen’s κ \kappa values from 0.36 to 0.55, providing an external reference for the audit decisions. Re-evaluating models trained on the original labels against corrected labels lowers F1 for every detector, and retraining on corrected labels recovers part of the loss for four of five detectors on each dataset. The merged benchmark further shows that high accuracy or AUROC can coexist with limited recall on imbalanced data. These results connect label quality to the interpretation of detector performance. The corrected benchmark, executable evidence, and reusable VulValidate skill provide a basis for more reliable vulnerability detection research, with label decisions tied to their supporting evidence and tested conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 两名专家对 581 个随机抽取的实例进行了盲审，支持率（确认率）为 90.0% 至 92.0%，标签修正率为 92.6% 至 99.0%；与独立生成的手动标签的一致性得出 Cohen’s κ \kappa 值在 0.36 到 0.55 之间，为审计决策提供了外部参考。 将基于原始标签训练的模型重新评估于修正后的标签上，导致所有检测器的 F1 值下降；而在修正后的标签上重新训练，则使五个检测器中四个在每组数据集上的损失得到部分恢复。 合并后的基准测试进一步表明，在不平衡数据中，高准确率或 AUROC 可以与有限的召回率共存。 这些结果将标签质量与检测器性能的解释联系起来。 修正后的基准测试、可执行的证据以及可重复使用的 VulValidate 技能，为更可靠的漏洞检测研究提供了基础，其中标签决策均与其支持证据和测试条件相关联。
